{{Quote|They've hit the main reactor, prepare to evacuate.|Adi Gallia, to a clone naval officer aboard her crippled flagship|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
A '''battle''' broke out near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]] came under [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]] by a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Gallia and her [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]], who had been bound for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], were caught by surprise by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and the main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] of their [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was quickly disabled.

Grievous then took a boarding party of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] aboard the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] to [[Prisoner/Legends|capture]] Gallia. While nonessential personnel evacuated from her [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] via [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] amidst ongoing [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter dogfights]], Gallia [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] Grievous in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], but she was overwhelmed and taken prisoner. Her [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], meanwhile, fell to [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from the enemy fleet. The Republic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had been aboard Gallia's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], managed to escape to Patitite Pattuna aboard a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] later launched a [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|rescue mission]] to free Gallia from custody aboard Grievous's [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|flagship]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You know these droids, Commander Wolffe?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. We transported them to Master Gallia's ship after we left the planet Aleen.|Plo Koon and Wolffe, on C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
[[File:Epguide405.jpg|thumb|left|250px|After departing from Aleen, C-3PO and R2-D2 were transferred to Master Gallia's flagship.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and her [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], set course to return to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> after assisting with a [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|relief effort]] on the [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]-devastated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gallia">{{SWE|characters|adigallia|Adi Gallia}}</ref> Before leaving Aleen, Gallia received passengers in the form of [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had been involved in the relief efforts and were heading home to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were transported to Gallia's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]].<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

While passing through the [[Patitite Pattuna system/Legends|Patitite Pattuna system]] near the neutral world of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]],<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Encyclopedia: Patitites">{{SWE|groups|patitites|Patitites}}</ref> Gallia's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was intercepted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who had located the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]].<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> With a history of targeting members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] such as Gallia,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gallia" /><ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref> Grievous launched an [[Space warfare/Legends|ambush]] with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] in the hopes of [[Prisoner/Legends|capturing]] Gallia,<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> with whom he had previously [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|clashed]] at [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

==The battle==
{{Quote|Avoid them the other way!|C-3PO, to R2-D2, while escaping from Adi Gallia's flagship|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
Grievous bore down on Gallia's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] with a pair of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and his own [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. Caught unprepared and outnumbered, the Republic cruiser was dealt a serious blow by the enemy [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] when its main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] was crippled by heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire. From the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of her embattled [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Gallia ordered a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] for their [[Troop/Legends|troops]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]], to begin evacuating from the crippled cruiser. Launching from the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] into [[Starfighter combat/Legends|battle]] against the Separatist [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]], targeting [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] that had been launched by the enemy fleet. Other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] pilots manned [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to assist in the evacuation of the 91st troops, with the ship's [[clone flight crew]] overseeing launches.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

[[File:GalliaVsGrievous-ND.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gallia duels Grievous while her men fight the boarding party of battle droids.]]
Moving in to capture Gallia, Grievous brought a boarding party of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] aboard the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] flagship, while his [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] continued to blast away at the cruiser. As nonessential personnel continued to evacuate, Gallia and others of her men met Grievous and his [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] in one of the ship's hallways to defend their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], with the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] exchanging the droids' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire while Gallia [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Grievous in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. As the battle droids overwhelmed the Republic troops and dealt a number of [[Death/Legends|casualties]], so did Gallia lose ground to Grievous, eventually being kicked backward toward an adjacent wall by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general. In the midst of the battle, C-3PO and R2-D2&mdash;searching for an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]&mdash;were able to commandeer a BTL-B Y-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that had been assigned to the [[R5-series astromech droid|astromech droid]]<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> [[R5-L26/Legends|R5-L26]].<ref name="Explore: Nomad Droids">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/nomad-droids-episode-guide|text="Nomad Droids" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Launching in the starfighter with C-3PO, R2-D2 piloted their ship out of the cruiser's hangar and escaped alongside other starfighters.<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> Thanks to his extensive experience as the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] companion to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="UK Comic 6.27">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.27|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.27]]</ref> R2-D2 was able to pilot the starfighter safely through the enemy [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire, and he even destroyed a Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]].<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

As her flagship began to break apart, Gallia was taken prisoner by Grievous and was brought aboard his [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. The abandoned cruiser, meanwhile, was blasted apart by the Separatist fleet. C-3PO and R2-D2 were pursued in their starfighter by a Vulture droid to the [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] of Patitite Pattuna, where the droid starfighter damaged their ship's reactor. R2-D2 was forced to crash-land the starfighter on the world's surface, though not before circling around and eliminating the pursuant Vulture droid.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Thanks for the rescue, Master Plo.|Adi Gallia, after being rescued by Plo Koon and the 104th Battalion|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
[[File:GalliaPrisoner-ND.png|thumb|right|250px|Gallia is held prisoner aboard General Grievous's destroyer.]]
With Gallia's capture and the destruction of her flagship, the battle resulted in a Confederate victory. Now a prisoner of Grievous, Gallia was [[Binders/Legends|handcuffed]] and held in custody aboard the bridge of the general's destroyer. Eventually, Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] received word of Gallia's capture and mounted an [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|operation]] with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe and the 104th [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] to rescue her. Meanwhile, C-3PO and R2-D2, having crash-landed on Patitite Pattuna, encountered the world's small but aggressive inhabitants, the [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]]. The two droids soon found themselves enveloped in a series of adventures that took them to the planet [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]], the [[Weequay pirate ship/Legends|Weequay pirate ship]] [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']], and, finally, Grievous's destroyer just as the battleship came under attack by Koon and his rescue fleet of Star Destroyers.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Adi Gallia has tangled with General Grievous on more than one occasion. Their swords crossed during the rescue of Eeth Koth, and again after a supply mission to Aleen.|Adi Gallia's Encyclopedia entry first mentions the battle|<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gallia" />}}
The battle at Patitite Pattuna was featured in "[[Nomad Droids]],"<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> the sixth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] that aired on [[October 14]], [[2011]].<ref name="Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Adi Gallia's duel with General Grievous, one of the battle's main elements, was first mentioned prior to then in Gallia's entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gallia" />
